name: search_photos
summary: Search the library like Photos' own Search field (scenes, places, dates, people, text); returns matching items with ids for get_photo/export_photo.

params.name: query
params.description: Search text, as typed into Photos' Search field (e.g. "beach", "Paris", "receipt").

params.name: limit
params.description: Max items to return (default 25, max 100).

name: list_photos
summary: List recent library items in native order — a bounded preview, not the whole library (use search_photos to find specific items). Returns ids + basic metadata.

params.name: limit
params.description: Max items to return (default 25, max 100).

name: get_photo
summary: Read one item's full metadata by id, including precise GPS location/altitude when present (returned only here, never in bulk listings).

params.name: id
params.description: Media item id from search_photos, list_photos, or get_album_photos.

name: export_photo
summary: Export one item out of the library to a file on disk by id so it can be viewed. Writes to a fresh dir (never overwrites); returns the path(s) and size. Defaults to a rendered JPEG.

params.name: id
params.description: Media item id from search_photos, list_photos, or get_album_photos.

params.name: destination
params.description: Directory to export into; a fresh subfolder is made inside it (nothing is overwritten). Leading ~ ok. Omit for a temp folder.

params.name: use_originals
params.description: Export the untouched original instead of a rendered JPEG (default false).

name: list_albums
summary: List user-created albums with id and item count; pass a name to get_album_photos.

name: list_photo_folders
summary: List folders in the library (folders group albums and other folders).

name: get_album_photos
summary: List items in a named album (bounded), with ids and basic metadata. Use list_albums for valid names.

params.name: album
params.description: Exact album name (see list_albums).

params.name: limit
params.description: Max items to return (default 25, max 100).

name: list_favorites
summary: List items in the Favorites album (bounded), with ids and basic metadata.

params.name: limit
params.description: Max items to return (default 25, max 100).

name: list_recently_deleted
summary: List items in Recently Deleted — pending permanent deletion, recoverable for 30 days (bounded).

params.name: limit
params.description: Max items to return (default 25, max 100).

name: get_selection
summary: List items currently selected in the Photos window — a bridge to "act on what I'm looking at". Empty if nothing is selected.

name: library_stats
summary: Report library totals: number of media items, albums, and folders.

name: set_favorite
summary: Mark an item as favorite, or remove the mark, by id. Undo restores the prior state.

params.name: id
params.description: Media item id from search_photos, list_photos, or get_album_photos.

params.name: favorite
params.description: true to favorite, false to remove the favorite mark.

name: set_title
summary: Set or clear an item's title by id. Undo restores the prior title.

params.name: id
params.description: Media item id from search_photos, list_photos, or get_album_photos.

params.name: title
params.description: New title; empty string clears it.

name: set_description
summary: Set or clear an item's description/caption by id. Undo restores the prior value.

params.name: id
params.description: Media item id from search_photos, list_photos, or get_album_photos.

params.name: description
params.description: New caption; empty string clears it.

name: set_date
summary: Change an item's date/time by id (item must already have a date, so undo can restore it). Undo restores the prior date.

params.name: id
params.description: Media item id from search_photos, list_photos, or get_album_photos.

params.name: date
params.description: New date as YYYY-MM-DD (e.g. 2024-07-04).

params.name: time
params.description: New time as 24-hour HH:MM (default 00:00).

name: set_keywords
summary: Replace an item's entire keyword list by id. Undo restores the prior keywords.

params.name: id
params.description: Media item id from search_photos, list_photos, or get_album_photos.

params.name: keywords
params.description: Complete new keyword list (REPLACES existing); empty list clears all.

name: create_album
summary: Create a new empty album, optionally inside a folder. No auto-undo — to reverse, delete the album by hand in Photos (photos unaffected).

params.name: name
params.description: Name of the new album.

params.name: parent_folder
params.description: Existing folder to create it inside (see list_photo_folders). Omit for top level.

name: create_folder
summary: Create a new empty folder (folders group albums and other folders), optionally inside another. No auto-undo — to reverse, delete the folder by hand in Photos.

params.name: name
params.description: Name of the new folder.

params.name: parent_folder
params.description: Existing folder to create it inside (see list_photo_folders). Omit for top level.

name: add_to_album
summary: Add existing items (by id) to an existing album; only changes membership, never copies the photo. No auto-undo — to reverse, remove the items by hand in Photos.

params.name: album
params.description: Exact name of the existing album (see list_albums).

params.name: ids
params.description: Media item ids to add (from search_photos, list_photos, or get_album_photos).

name: import_photos
summary: Import image/video files from disk into the library, optionally into an album. No auto-undo — to reverse, delete the imports by hand in Photos (then in Recently Deleted, 30 days).

params.name: files
params.description: Paths to image/video files to import. Leading ~ ok.

params.name: album
params.description: Existing album to add imports to (see list_albums). Omit to skip.
